goal.question: Which product category contributed the largest absolute GMV change?

sql:
WITH items AS (
      SELECT order_id, product_id, seller_id, price, freight_value, p.product_category_name_english AS category,
             seller_state FROM order_items JOIN products_with_category_translation p USING(product_id)
      JOIN sellers USING(seller_id) 
    ), cohort AS (
      SELECT *, CASE WHEN ts >= '2018-06-01' AND ts < '2018-07-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS period FROM (SELECT o.order_id, order_purchase_timestamp AS ts, order_status, customer_state,
             (order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date)::INT AS late
             , i.* EXCLUDE (order_id)
             FROM orders o JOIN customers USING(customer_id) JOIN items i USING(order_id)) AS source WHERE (ts >= '2018-05-01' AND ts < '2018-06-01') OR (ts >= '2018-06-01' AND ts < '2018-07-01')
    ) SELECT period, COUNT(*) AS item_lines, SUM(price) AS gmv, AVG(price) AS avg_price,
                        COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS category_orders,
                        COUNT(*)::DOUBLE / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS lines_per_order,
                        SUM(freight_value) AS freight_value FROM cohort GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

             seller_state FROM order_items JOIN products_with_category_translation p USING(product_id)
      JOIN sellers USING(seller_id) 
    ), cohort AS (
      SELECT *, CASE WHEN ts >= '2018-06-01' AND ts < '2018-07-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS period FROM (SELECT o.order_id, order_purchase_timestamp AS ts, order_status, customer_state,
             (order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date)::INT AS late
             , i.* EXCLUDE (order_id)
             FROM orders o JOIN customers USING(customer_id) JOIN items i USING(order_id)) AS source WHERE (ts >= '2018-05-01' AND ts < '2018-06-01') OR (ts >= '2018-06-01' AND ts < '2018-07-01')
    ) SELECT period, COALESCE(category, '(unknown)') AS key, SUM(price) AS value FROM cohort GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

sql:
WITH items AS (
      SELECT order_id, product_id, seller_id, price, freight_value, p.product_category_name_english AS category,
             seller_state FROM order_items JOIN products_with_category_translation p USING(product_id)
      JOIN sellers USING(seller_id) WHERE p.product_category_name_english = 'health_beauty'
    ), cohort AS (
      SELECT *, CASE WHEN ts >= '2018-04-01' AND ts < '2018-05-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS period FROM (SELECT o.order_id, order_purchase_timestamp AS ts, order_status, customer_state,
             (order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date)::INT AS late
             , i.* EXCLUDE (order_id)
             FROM orders o JOIN customers USING(customer_id) JOIN items i USING(order_id)) AS source WHERE (ts >= '2018-03-01' AND ts < '2018-04-01') OR (ts >= '2018-04-01' AND ts < '2018-05-01')
    ) SELECT period, COUNT(*) AS item_lines, SUM(price) AS gmv, AVG(price) AS avg_price,
                        COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS category_orders,
                        COUNT(*)::DOUBLE / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS lines_per_order,
                        SUM(freight_value) AS freight_value FROM cohort GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH items AS (
      SELECT order_id, product_id, seller_id, price, freight_value, p.product_category_name_english AS category,
             seller_state FROM order_items JOIN products_with_category_translation p USING(product_id)
      JOIN sellers USING(seller_id) WHERE p.product_category_name_english = 'health_beauty'
    ), cohort AS (
      SELECT *, CASE WHEN ts >= '2018-04-01' AND ts < '2018-05-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS period FROM (SELECT o.order_id, order_purchase_timestamp AS ts, order_status, customer_state,
             (order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date)::INT AS late
             , i.* EXCLUDE (order_id)
             FROM orders o JOIN customers USING(customer_id) JOIN items i USING(order_id)) AS source WHERE (ts >= '2018-03-01' AND ts < '2018-04-01') OR (ts >= '2018-04-01' AND ts < '2018-05-01')
    ), latest AS (
          SELECT order_id, review_score FROM order_reviews
          QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY review_answer_timestamp DESC NULLS LAST,
            review_creation_date DESC NULLS LAST, review_id, review_score) = 1

          SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT period, order_id, late FROM cohort) LEFT JOIN latest USING(order_id)

                COUNT(review_score)::DOUBLE / COUNT(*) AS coverage, AVG((review_score <= 2)::INT) AS negative_rate
                FROM reviewed GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

             FROM orders o JOIN customers USING(customer_id) JOIN items i USING(order_id)) AS source WHERE (ts >= '2018-03-01' AND ts < '2018-04-01') OR (ts >= '2018-04-01' AND ts < '2018-05-01')
    ) SELECT period, COUNT(late) AS eligible_orders, COUNT(*) AS category_orders, AVG(late) AS late_rate
            FROM (SELECT DISTINCT period, order_id, late FROM cohort) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH items AS (
      SELECT order_id, product_id, seller_id, price, freight_value, p.product_category_name_english AS category,
             seller_state FROM order_items JOIN products_with_category_translation p USING(product_id)
      JOIN sellers USING(seller_id) WHERE p.product_category_name_english = 'health_beauty'
    ), cohort AS (
      SELECT *, CASE WHEN ts >= '2018-04-01' AND ts < '2018-05-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS period FROM (SELECT o.order_id, order_purchase_timestamp AS ts, order_status, customer_state,
             (order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date)::INT AS late
             , i.* EXCLUDE (order_id)
             FROM orders o JOIN customers USING(customer_id) JOIN items i USING(order_id)) AS source WHERE (ts >= '2018-03-01' AND ts < '2018-04-01') OR (ts >= '2018-04-01' AND ts < '2018-05-01')
    ), latest AS (
          SELECT order_id, review_score FROM order_reviews
          QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY review_answer_timestamp DESC NULLS LAST,
            review_creation_date DESC NULLS LAST, review_id, review_score) = 1
        ), reviewed AS (
          SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT period, order_id, late FROM cohort) LEFT JOIN latest USING(order_id)
        ) SELECT period, late, COUNT(review_score) AS reviewed_orders,
                AVG((review_score <= 2)::INT) AS negative_rate FROM reviewed
                WHERE late IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
